name: media-figure.scss
html:
// ── Media Figure Shadow DOM styles ────────────────────────────────────────────
// These styles apply INSIDE the <media-figure> Shadow Root.
// Because Shadow DOM is isolated, rules from internals.scss (.internal-main figure,
// .internal-extra-item .render-media, etc.) cannot pierce into this shadow root.
// All styles that target figure, .render-placeholder, and .render-media must live
// here so they are injected into the correct Shadow Root scope.
//
// CSS custom properties (--mf-w, --mf-h, --mf-max-w) ARE inherited across shadow
// boundaries — they are set by internals.scss on the <media-figure> host element
// and read here to achieve context-aware sizing.

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// ── Shadow host ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

@supports selector(:host-context(*)) {
  :host-context(.internal-extra-item) {
    width: auto;
  }
}

// In carousel slide context: let host shrink to content width (the placeholder drives it)
:host(.internal-extra-item),
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item']) {
  width: auto;
}

:host(.internal-main-item),
:host([classes*='internal-main-item']) {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;

  figure {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 70vh;
    max-height: 70dvh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
    -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
    -webkit-mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(var(--color-white-raw), var(--black));
    mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(var(--color-white-raw), var(--black));
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);

    @include layout-1024() {
      -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
  }

  .render-placeholder {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    height: auto;
    // On mobile: stretch full width
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      // At tablet+: use natural SVG dimensions, cap at container
      width: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: 70vh;
      max-height: 70dvh;
    }
  }

  .render-media,
  video.render-media {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    // Cover section is always full-bleed: fill and crop anchored to top center.
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: top center;
    -webkit-border-radius: inherit;
    border-radius: inherit;
  }
}

// ── Zoom-to-fill cover media ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// When ztf-video is set alongside internal-main-item, the video is intentionally
// full-bleed: it fills the frame and crops to top-center (e.g. hero backgrounds).
// This overrides the contain default set in the :host(.internal-main-item) block.
:host(.ztf-video.internal-main-item),
:host([classes*='ztf-video'][classes*='internal-main-item']),
:host(.ztf-video),
:host([classes*='ztf-video']) {
  .render-placeholder {
    // Fill full width in ztf mode so the container spans the section
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: 70vh;
      max-height: 70dvh;
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      // Ultra-wide bleed cap: without it, width:100% on a 5K viewport
      // makes the 70vh height clamp crop the video to a panoramic sliver
      // (≈5:1 displayed aspect). 175dvh keeps ≈2.5:1 — still full-bleed
      // cinematic, but the top-anchored crop stays readable.
      max-width: 175vh;
      max-width: 175dvh;
    }
  }

  figure {
    // The placeholder caps the bleed, but the media layers absolutely
    // fill the *figure* — it must carry the same cap or the crop remains.
    @include layout-2560() {
      max-width: 175vh;
      max-width: 175dvh;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }
  }

  .render-media,
  video.render-media {
    // Zoom-to-fill: fill frame and crop anchored to top center
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: top center;
  }
}

// ── Figure wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
figure {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);

  @include layout-1024() {
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  }
}

// ── Loading shimmer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Until a media layer paints (thumb img, high-res img, or the first video
// frame — all signalled by media-figure--loaded on the host), the transparent
// SVG placeholder would leave a blank box on slow networks. Reuse the global
// skeleton shimmer sweep so the slot reads as "decoding", matching the
// pre-data skeleton state. The ::before sits under the absolutely-positioned
// media layers (z-index 1/2) and below the transparent placeholder in paint
// order, so loaded media simply covers it.
:host(:not(.media-figure--loaded)) figure::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    105deg,
    transparent 30%,
    var(--skel-bg-2) 45%,
    var(--skel-bg-2) 55%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  animation: skeleton-shimmer 1.8s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  figure::before {
    animation: none;
  }
}

// The store-driven reduced-motion flag mirrors the media query inside shadow
// DOM, where the global html.reduced-motion sweep cannot reach.
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) figure::before {
  animation: none;
}

@supports selector(:host-context(*)) {
  :host-context(.internal-extra-item) figure {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background-color: var(--grey-3);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-md);

    @include layout-1024() {
      background: none;
      border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
  }
}

// When inside .internal-extra-item context (carousel slide item):
// the figure needs flex centering and a grey background for the loading state.
:host(.internal-extra-item) figure,
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item']) figure {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background-color: var(--grey-3);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);

  @include layout-1024() {
    background: none;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  }
}

// ── SVG placeholder — maintains aspect ratio before image loads ───────────────
// The transparent SVG img sets the intrinsic size; all media layers are
// absolutely positioned on top of it.
// Default: on mobile, stretch full-width of host. On tablet+, use natural
// SVG dimensions (set via width/height attributes) so media never exceeds
// the source resolution.
.render-placeholder {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  height: auto;
  // Mobile: full-width so the media fills the screen
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;

  @include layout-768() {
    // Tablet+: respect the SVG's intrinsic width/height attributes
    // so small images are not scaled up beyond their native resolution.
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
}

@supports selector(:host-context(*)) {
  :host-context(.internal-extra-item) .render-placeholder {
    position: relative;
    // Carousel strip contract: every slide shares the --mf-h strip height
    // so media always fills the row. Width stays aspect-driven (auto →
    // height × intrinsic ratio) capped by --mf-w on mobile/tablet and
    // --mf-max-w (or the viewport gutter calc) on desktop, with a 320px
    // floor at ≥375px viewports — very tall media used to collapse to
    // unusable slivers when only max-* caps applied.
    height: var(--mf-h, calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));
    height: var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));
    width: auto;
    max-width: var(--mf-w, calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));

    @include layout-375() {
      min-width: to-rem(320);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)}));
    }
  }
}

// When inside .internal-extra-item context (carousel slides): the strip
// height is pinned to --mf-h so every slide fills the carousel row, width
// is aspect-driven (auto → height × intrinsic ratio) capped by --mf-w on
// mobile/tablet and by --mf-max-w (or the viewport-gutter calc: item
// padding + 24px margins per side) on desktop, and floored at 320px on
// ≥375px viewports so tall media keep a usable touch target instead of
// collapsing to slivers. The transparent placeholder only sizes the box —
// the real media layers cover-crop it, so a floored/capped width never
// distorts the image. These vars cross the shadow boundary from
// internals.scss / carousel-host.scss.
:host(.internal-extra-item) .render-placeholder,
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item']) .render-placeholder {
  position: relative;
  height: var(--mf-h, calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));
  height: var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));
  width: auto;
  max-width: var(--mf-w, calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));

  @include layout-375() {
    min-width: to-rem(320);
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    height: var(--mf-h, calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)}));
    height: var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)}));
    max-width: var(--mf-w, calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)}));
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    height: var(--mf-h, #{to-rem($space-7xl)});
    // --mf-max-w is only declared for landscape items — regular slides get
    // the viewport-gutter cap (padding + 24px margin clearance per side).
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)}));
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    height: var(--mf-h, #{to-rem($space-8xl)});
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)}));
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    height: var(--mf-h, #{to-rem($space-9xl)});
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)}));
  }
}

// Landscape items keep the same fixed --mf-h strip height as every other
// slide — only the width cap relaxes to viewport-gutter margins so wide
// media can stretch across most of the viewport. max-height must NOT be
// re-declared here: with an explicit `height` the max-* constraint would
// still clamp the used height and re-introduce the ragged-height bug.
:host(.internal-extra-item.landscape) .render-placeholder,
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item'][classes*='landscape']) .render-placeholder {
  @include layout-1024() {
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)}));
  }

  @include layout-1280() {
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl)}));
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-7xl)}));
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-6xl)}));
  }
}

// ── Media layers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Two-layer progressive cross-fade:
//   Layer 1 (--thumb): blurred thumbnail visible immediately
//   Layer 2 (--high):  full-res, fades in when loaded via .render-media--loaded
.render-media {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top center;
  box-sizing: border-box;

  @include layout-1024() {
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  // Thumbnail: blurred + slightly zoomed to hide blur edge artifacts
  &--thumb {
    filter: blur(12px);
    transform: scale(1.05);
    z-index: 1;
  }

  // High-res overlay: invisible until loaded
  &--high {
    opacity: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: opacity 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    will-change: opacity;

    &.render-media--loaded {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

// ── Video element ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Carousel / extra-item context: videos fill their slide container.
// The :host(.internal-main-item) block above overrides this for cover media.
video.render-media {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top center;

  @include layout-1024() {
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  }
}

// ── Expand modal trigger buttons ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// exp-md-open-1: styled in modal.scss with animated corner borders
// exp-md-open-2: invisible overlay for full-figure click area
.exp-md-open-2 {
  display: none;
}
